highlights.text: ‘How can you sit so level?’ she whispered at him. ‘Like… like you knew it was coming.’ Still he didn’t look at her. ‘It’s always coming.’
We must seize the moment! That has always been my motto. Note that down, Sworbreck.’ Sweet raised his brows. ‘Might not be long ’til your motto is, “I can’t feel my fucking feet.”
‘All times are end times for someone.’
Strange, how the best moments of our lives we scarcely notice except in looking back.
